purpose: Non-authoritative review/action handoff for the 150 DB01 source candidates not yet classified active or retired; does not transfer task reservations.
coordinationRules: No permanent domain owner by Chat number; assignments below are cross-task review suggestions, not claims.
DB-004 must reconcile identity semantics itself; DB-005 academic, DB-007 profile, DB-012 recruiter tasks must acknowledge shared fields before final gate.
Do not mark any source candidate retired because another task is expected to review it.
No runtime semantic verification, migrations or PostgreSQL tests were executed by this ledger.
